source: Mouthful design doc pp. 6-9 (The six paths): stats are multipliers on the tier's base; one ability on the right mouse button and one passive per form. Claw ranges, colours and the tells (doc p. 15) where the OCR lost them are ours.

forms.name: Moray
forms.ability_text: Dash: a 6 m burst in 0.3 s
forms.passive_text: Hole-dweller: hides in any eel hole up to tier 3
forms.tell: the body coils before a dash

forms.name: Sea Snake
forms.ability_text: Dash: 5 m in a quarter second
forms.passive_text: Venom: bites poison for 3 s (2% mass a second)
forms.tell: the body coils before a dash

forms.name: Conger
forms.ability_text: Lunge: a 10 m dash that bites at the end
forms.passive_text: Drag: a bite on a smaller fish pulls it 3 m toward you
forms.tell: the body coils before a lunge

forms.name: Marine Crocodile
forms.ability_text: Death Roll: a dash-grab that holds for 2 s and takes 15% mass
forms.passive_text: Armored back: hits from above do half
forms.tell: the tail coils before the roll

forms.name: Oarfish King
forms.ability_text: Ribbon Dash: three chained 8 m dashes
forms.passive_text: Omen: nearby bots flee you; players see a ripple
forms.tell: the long fin ripples before the ribbon

forms.name: Reef Squid
forms.ability_text: Ink: a 5 m cloud that blinds for 3 s (you see through your own)
forms.passive_text: Jet: speed +30% for 1 s after Ink
forms.tell: it goes pale before inking

forms.name: Octopus
forms.ability_text: Ink: a bigger cloud, 8 m for 4 s
forms.passive_text: Camouflage: unseen while still for 1 s; a bite holds for 1 s
forms.tell: it goes pale before inking

forms.name: Cuttlefish
forms.ability_text: Dazzle: a flash that reverses an enemy's controls for 2 s
forms.passive_text: Hover: no stamina cost to hold position
forms.tell: its skin strobes before the dazzle

forms.name: Giant Pacific Octopus
forms.ability_text: Ink Wall: a 15 m curtain for 6 s; nothing sees through it
forms.passive_text: Eight Arms: a bite holds its target 1.5 s
forms.tell: it goes pale before the wall

forms.name: Colossal Squid
forms.ability_text: Hook Tentacles: a 12 m reach that pulls a target to the beak
forms.passive_text: Trench-born: full sight in the dark
forms.tell: the long arms curl before the hook

forms.name: Dogfish
forms.ability_text: Frenzy: +40% bite for 3 s
forms.passive_text: Blood sense: see blood trails 30 m off
forms.tell: its pectorals drop before a frenzy

forms.name: Bull Shark
forms.ability_text: Ram: a charge that knocks back 5 m and stuns 1 s
forms.passive_text: Thick skin: -20% damage taken
forms.tell: its pectorals drop before a ram

forms.name: Hammerhead
forms.ability_text: Pin: hold a target against the floor or wall for 2 s
forms.passive_text: Electroreception: see buried and hidden fish within 15 m
forms.tell: its pectorals drop before a pin

forms.name: Great White
forms.ability_text: Breach: a vertical charge from below that tears away a quarter of what it hits
forms.passive_text: Apex: the NPC sharks ignore you
forms.tell: it sinks and turns up before a breach

forms.name: Tiger Shark
forms.ability_text: Frenzy: +60% bite for 5 s
forms.passive_text: Iron stomach: armored prey costs no teeth; eats anything
forms.tell: its pectorals drop before a frenzy

forms.name: Mantis Shrimp
forms.ability_text: Punch: a 4 m snap that stuns 1 s
forms.passive_text: Burrow: bury in sand or silt (unseen; 2 s to dig)
forms.tell: it raises a claw before the punch

forms.name: Spiny Lobster
forms.ability_text: Tail Flip: a 6 m backward jump
forms.passive_text: Spines: melee attackers take 5% of their bite back
forms.tell: its tail curls before the flip

forms.name: Coconut Crab
forms.ability_text: Jump: a 5 m leap in any direction, even up a wall
forms.passive_text: Crusher: eats armored prey freely; climbs walls
forms.tell: it crouches before the jump

forms.name: King Crab
forms.ability_text: Claw Slam: a 6 m shockwave along the floor that knocks swimmers up
forms.passive_text: Fortress: -40% damage from the front
forms.tell: it raises both claws before the slam

forms.name: Giant Isopod
forms.ability_text: Roll: curl up: immune for 3 s, can't move
forms.passive_text: Scavenger: corpses give double mass; the brine pool is water to you
forms.tell: its plates tighten before the roll

forms.name: Puffer
forms.ability_text: Inflate: double size for 3 s; nothing under tier 5 can swallow you; biters lose 10%
forms.passive_text: Spines: biters lose 3% of their mass
forms.tell: a visible intake before inflating

forms.name: Porcupinefish
forms.ability_text: Inflate: 4 s, biters lose 15%
forms.passive_text: Barbed: a biter bleeds 2% a second for 3 s
forms.tell: a visible intake before inflating

forms.name: Boxfish
forms.ability_text: Toxin Cloud: a 6 m cloud: 3% mass a second for 4 s
forms.passive_text: Armor plates: -30% damage
forms.tell: its colours pulse before the toxin

forms.name: Titan Puffer
forms.ability_text: Detonate: burst: 20% mass to everything in 8 m; you drop a tier
forms.passive_text: Untouchable: nothing under tier 7 can swallow you
forms.tell: a long intake before the burst

forms.name: Stonefish
forms.ability_text: Ambush: become part of the floor; the first bite takes 40%
forms.passive_text: Venom spines: biters lose 10% and are poisoned 5 s
forms.tell: none: its ambush is silent and only seen

forms.name: Blobfish
forms.ability_text: None
forms.passive_text: None; it looks sad
forms.tell: none: it does nothing

forms.name: Bigger Blobfish
forms.ability_text: None
forms.passive_text: Still none
forms.tell: none

forms.name: Enormous Blobfish
forms.ability_text: None
forms.passive_text: A quiet dignity
forms.tell: none

forms.name: The Blobfish King
forms.ability_text: None
forms.passive_text: The crown fits badly
forms.tell: none
